# A component the program declares with a public mark is a primitive, and a
# primitive has no body by design.
#
# Lowering drops a bodyless component when building for a target, because one
# that declares nothing renders nothing and every platform used to guess
# differently at what an empty component meant. A marked one is the exception:
# #[draw.shape] says the node is a member of the drawing tree and passCanvas
# emits it, so dropping it takes the canvas contents with it.
#
# The marks are the whole list -- #[intrinsic], #[builtin], a wildcard pattern,
# a tree kind -- but only a tree kind is reachable from user code, so it is what
# this asserts. Without the exemption the canvas emits no draw calls at all and
# still exits 0.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=out main.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The canvas renders, and the marked shape inside it reached passCanvas.
grep 'ctx\.save\(\)' out/index.html
grep 'ctx\.restore\(\)' out/index.html

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:ui/draw"

#[draw.shape]
component blip(x float, y float) {}

component main() {
    window(title="t") {
        draw.canvas(width=100px, height=100px) {
            blip(x=1.0, y=2.0)
        }
    }
}
